name: Άγιος Νικόλαος
evidence: Pin (36.976, 21.658) is on the Ionian coast between Marathopoli and Vromoneri (Trifylia), NOT the Mani village that round 1 (and all search results) describe — the Pantazi-beach sunbed evidence belongs to Agios Nikolaos of Messinian Mani, a different coast entirely. No source exists for an Agios Nikolaos beach at this Marathopoli-area locality; the Gargaliani beach lists (Marathos, Lagouvardos, Ai-Giannakis, Vromoneri, Agia Sotira, Chrysi Akti) do not include one.

name: Βρωμονέρι
evidence: Disambiguated to the Vromoneri settlement 7 km from Gargaliani (matches pin 37.018, 21.620). messinia.mobi/completegreece beach pages: «Μέρος της αποτελεί οργανωμένη παραλία, με beach bar, ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες, beach-volley» — the rest of the beach stays free. Corroborated by the round-1 2025 municipal umbrella/sunbed concession auction for this beach.

name: Λιβάδια
evidence: Pin (36.795, 21.964) resolves to Koroni, not the island namesakes round 1 hit. koroni-messinias.gr lists «Παραλία κάτω από το κάστρο (Λειβαδιά)» so the beach exists at Koroni, but the page is a photo gallery with no facilities text; the organized Koroni beaches with sunbeds are Zaga and Memi, distinct beaches. No facility statement found for Livadia itself.

name: Παραλία Σάλιο
evidence: Disambiguated to the cove by Trachila village, Messinian Mani (pin 36.888, 22.231). Salio is reached only via a footpath starting at a bend before the village (messinianmani.gr, AllTrails lists it as a hike POI); the area's beaches are described as untouched by mass tourism. No source mentions any commercial facility; inference from path-only access, not an explicit statement.

name: Παραλία Χωμάτι
evidence: Disambiguated to the beach below Vounaria village north of Koroni (pin 36.83, 21.932). Athinorama: «οι παραλίες Περούλια και Χωμάτι (κάτω από το χωριό Βουνάρια) με τους αμμόλοφους και τις καλαμιές είναι το κρυμμένο μυστικό των ντόπιων» — described as a locals' hidden spot with dunes and reeds; no source mentions any facility. Not an explicit 'unorganized' statement, hence low confidence.

name: Ξετρυπητή
evidence: Anafi-wide sources are unanimous: the island's beaches «δεν είναι οργανωμένες», no sunbeds even at the top beaches (travel.gr: 'Πεντακάθαρα νερά και ειδυλλιακά τοπία χωρίς ξαπλώστρες'; greecedestination: 'virgin beaches... not organized'). Xetrypiti is a minor remote beach that does not appear in any organized listing; on an island where even Kleisidi/Katsouni lack full organization, facilities here are implausible.

name: Σιφνέικο
evidence: Locality confirmed (Sifneiko/Sunset beach, west coast of Antiparos town). Sources conflict: one guide says 'a single small bar near the middle... limited sunbeds', another says 'largely unorganized, no sunbeds or immediate bars'. The adjacent Sunset Antiparos bar operates evenings only (18:00-00:30) for drinks, not daytime sunbed service. Cannot safely claim daytime organization.

name: Καλαμίτσι
evidence: Disambiguated to Kimolos (south side, next to Bonatsa) — Halkidiki/Lefkada namesakes excluded. Kimolos-specific guides (feelgreece/allovergreece) describe it as «ανοργάνωτη παραλία», a small sandy cove with tamarisks where locals bring children; only facility is a taverna ~10 m behind the beach — no sunbeds, no bar.

name: Μαυροσπηλιά
evidence: Kimolos-specific pages agree: 'the beach is not organized but a refreshment stand (αναψυκτήριο) operates' selling water/soft drinks/snacks, and visitors are told to bring their own umbrella since there is no shade. The round-1 'sunbeds in recent years' claim is contradicted by the more specific current descriptions; canteen is not a beach bar.

name: Άγιος Στέφανος
evidence: Locality pinned (bay in front of the Agios Stefanos settlement, east Kythnos). kythnos.net describes sand/pebbles and plenty of tamarisk shade along its length, but neither confirms sunbeds nor states it is unorganized; all sunbed hits are Corfu/Kos/Mykonos namesakes. Island-wide 'very few Kythnos beaches are organized' but not beach-specific.

name: Αγία Ειρήνη
evidence: Disambiguated to the beach opposite Loutra, NE Kythnos (kythnos.net page is beach-specific): «Επειδή πρόκειται για μια μικρή μη οργανωμένη παραλία καλό θα είναι να προσέλθετε με τα βασικά» — small non-organized beach, shade only from scattered tamarisks.

name: Παραλία Κολώνα
evidence: Kythnos Kolona unambiguous (isthmus to Agios Loukas islet). Recent specific reports: one section rents umbrellas/sunbeds at €30 for 2 front-row / €20 back row, plus a taverna above the beach and a café-snack beach bar. Older guides still say 'not organized, bring equipment' — the priced, operator-specific recent account wins per recency/specificity; main sandy isthmus remains free.

name: Κήποι
evidence: Second pass (Greek 'Κήπος Μήλος οργανωμένη/καντίνα' variants) still returns no Milos-specific facility source — results collide with Kipos Samothraki and generic Milos guides that describe other organized beaches (Fyriplaka, Provatas) but say nothing about this south-coast beach. Genuinely unresolvable.

name: Αγία Άννα
evidence: Pin (37.4489, 25.3298) is the small Agia Anna town beach at Mykonos Chora. Mykonos has three Agia Anna bearers: the Kalafatis one (sunbeds, beach volley, diving center) and the Paraga one (sunbeds/umbrellas) — both ~25.34-25.42 lng, not this one. No facility source found for the Chora town beach itself; all organized-beach evidence belongs to the namesakes.

name: Αγία Τριάδα
evidence: Pin (37.4149, 25.2124) is not on Mykonos at all — it is on Rhenia (Rineia), the uninhabited islet west of Delos. Sources confirm Agia Triada is one of Rhenia's west-coast beaches by the chapel/abandoned farmhouses: the island is uninhabited with 'many deserted, sandy beaches' reachable only by boat. No inhabitants, no facilities possible.

name: Άμπραμ
evidence: Locality certain (NW Naxos coast between Chora and Apollonas). Naxos-specific pages (allovergreece, naxos-tours) describe a small sandy cove with a small settlement and a taverna next to it, 'less developed' than the organized west-coast beaches — but no source explicitly states presence or absence of sunbeds, and the taverna is adjacent rather than a beach bar.

name: Παραλία Αγκάλη Χρυσής Ακτής
evidence: All facility evidence (umbrellas/sunbeds for rent, beach bars, windsurf centers) is for the main Chrysi Akti / Golden Beach and Punda; no source individuates the Agkali sub-cove at the pin. Per the no-adjacent-beach-promotion rule this stays unresolved.

name: Κάθαρος
evidence: Katharos below Oia, Santorini — beach-specific pages are explicit and consistent: 'unorganized beach with no sunbeds along the shore... no facilities, no shower, no sunbed rentals or toilet' (santorini-view; santorini-more agrees: no commercial amenities). The Katharos Lounge meze bar is above/off the beach (matches our 'εκτός ακτής' note). The round-1 'umbrellas exist' claim is contradicted by the more specific beach pages.

name: Σεράλια
evidence: Locality certain (~30 m pebble cove at Kastro's old port, Sifnos). One aggregated account mentions 'some municipal umbrellas', while the beach-specific pages (sifnosinfo, roomsinsifnos) describe only the tiny pebble beach with small tavernas adjacent and warn of waves/undercurrents — no sunbed/organization statement. Conflicting and thin; not promoted.

name: Αγκάλη
evidence: Second pass still cannot pin an 'Agkali' beach on Tinos: a bare Tripadvisor stub ('Agali Beach, Tinos') exists with no content, and every substantive result is the Folegandros, Evia or Thesprotia namesake. Tinos beach roundups (tinos360, tinosecret) between Chora and Kionia list Stavros/Agios Markos but no Agkali. Unresolvable.

name: Παραλία Σταυρός
evidence: Disambiguated: Stavros just after Tinos Chora towards Kionia, the old port with the namesake chapel (matches pin) — Crete/Chalkidiki/Donousa namesakes excluded. tinosecret.gr beach-specific listing states 'ORGANIZED: No' — sandy, shallow, natural tree shade, busy despite lacking formal facilities. An αναψυκτήριο operates by the church (off-beach), matching our existing amenity note.

name: Ψιλή Άμμος
evidence: Disambiguated to Schinoussa (500 m from Mesaria, NE coast; Samos/Thasos/Fourni namesakes excluded). Schinoussa-specific sources: 'There is no organization whatsoever at the beach, so you will need to bring all necessary supplies' — 60 m of sand and dunes, shade only from tamarisks.

name: Άγιος Βασίλειος
evidence: Beach right after Livadi, Astypalaia, named for the church there. The island's dedicated beach page (astypalaia-island.gr) describes only relaxing 'under the shade of the huge trees along the beach', calls it 'quite quiet and peaceful' and under-visited, and lists no sunbeds/canteen/bar — explicitly contrasted with the organized, cosmopolitan Livadi next door. Absence-based, hence low confidence.

name: Μακρύγιαλος
evidence: Second pass confirms round 1: every substantive 'Makrygialos' result is Crete (Lasithi, organized) or Pieria — both wrong localities. No Karpathos source (municipal all-beaches page, allovergreece's 41 Karpathos beaches, discovergreece top-10) mentions a Makrygialos at the pin (35.425, 27.151, SE coast near Amoopi?). The windsurf/beach-bar amenity claims cannot be verified for Karpathos; genuinely unresolvable.

name: Μανδράκι
evidence: Locality certain (Mandraki district east of Kastellorizo harbor, by the cemetery — the islet's only small sandy patch, which the municipality tops up with sand each summer). Conflicting/vague: greecedestination says sunbeds/umbrellas 'are placed by the Municipality and in very few places' (island-wide, not clearly at Mandraki), while the beach-specific cavoblue page describes only pebbles/sand and clean shallow water with no facility mention. Cannot pin municipal sunbeds to this exact spot.

name: Πλάκες
evidence: Plakes on Kastellorizo is a natural flat-rock (slippery slabs) swimming spot, not a serviced beach; the organized swimming area of the island — sunbeds and a small taverna — is on the Agios Georgios islet reached by boat, a different location. No source attributes any facility to Plakes itself. Absence-based inference, low confidence.

name: Άσπρη
evidence: Aspri, Patmos: small isolated cove between Skala and Meloi with view of the Monastery (matches pin). patmosislandinfo/taxidologio describe sand and fine pebble, tamarisks for shade and a fish taverna at one end; explicitly characterized as quiet/isolated, never listed among Patmos' organized beaches, and no sunbed mention anywhere. Taverna at the edge is not a beach bar.
